title: Society of Theater Organists, the baseball team and the union
summary: Her husband's society membership, his owning a baseball team, and her union membership.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Yeah. Oh, and they had the Society of Theater Organists. I noticed that in the Union book, they're always talking about S-T-O, and your husband was a member of that.
Did you see this when you were looking for him? Oh, yes. I saw the baseball team. The baseball team.
He managed them and everything, huh?
He was a manager and owned them. I don't know about him. He made any money out of that. Not even if I did say.
Well, that's probably what he enjoyed doing.
Did you belong to the Union then? Yeah, I belonged to the Union.
You must have if you wrote for the magazine.
I belonged to the Union, yeah. And I did until I think I went out of town or wasn't here anymore. None of those small towns in Mississippi. You know, you didn't have to belong to anything to work.
